spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶2:** Two profound arcana are made manifest in Divine Wisdom — in its influx into the understanding and in its withdrawal. At the moment when Divine Wisdom flows into the mind and becomes perceived in the whole of the human spirit, all affections of the natural man are awakened from their spiritual obscurity toward the splendor of that wisdom, and the interior faculties of the mind are opened to receive it. Yet at the close of a spiritual state, when Divine Wisdom withdraws from conscious perception, all thoughts from every region of the mind and even all natural affections return into their obscure states of falsity. The faculties of the entire spirit close themselves against influx, and a state of spiritual ignorance overtakes them. They withdraw inward and remain within that darkness of falsity in their states of concealment.

**¶3:** Exceedingly great is this arcanum revealed by Divine Wisdom! For when wisdom rises and becomes perceived at the beginning of a new spiritual state, all the faculties of the natural mind open themselves, and all human thought and every natural affection goes forth into the external mind — to consume and lay waste to the Divine Truth that is silently established in the natural degree, held there in a state of patient endurance.

**¶4:** This pertains to the arcanum of the Primordial Celestial State, because when it proceeded forth from the Divine Itself, it shone with its radiance over all the powers of falsity from evil. At that moment all the forces of falsity and evil came forth from their interior repositories — their dominions and their hosts — abandoning their hidden states and their deepest hell. They laid waste to the [GAP-1] external form of truth belonging to the five faculties of celestial perception, which had been arrayed as protecting truths around that interior celestial state, in that first great spiritual combat.

**¶5:** Again, when Divine Wisdom withdraws from the conscious spirit and recedes from perception, and all faculties of the mind return into their concealed states and interior habitations and are hidden — this likewise pertains to the arcanum of the final end: it prefigures the consummation of all spiritual states. For when all wisdom and truth shall have been purified and liberated throughout the whole spirit at the last, the collecting principle of all things — the Ultimate Perfected Form of the Divine Human — will gather into itself and complete its own likeness. It is the final state of that spiritual day, the time when the Perfected Divine Human will ascend into the celestial kingdom. The adversary also — spiritual death itself — will enter into confinement: into the hell appointed for those who rejected truth and profaned good, who loved falsity rather than wisdom. They will enter with it into that bondage, and the state of spiritual darkness overtakes them; and from that time forward the name "wisdom" will not illuminate them.

**¶6:** Behold, the two arcana made visible perpetually in Divine Wisdom — which is this resplendent source of all spiritual illumination.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Two great mysteries are apparent in this shining sun, at its rising and setting. Now, at the moment when it rises and is visible in the universe, all creatures of flesh shall lift up their heads fr[om their sleep] towards the splendour of the sun, and open their doors. While at evening time, when the sun sinks from the universe, all people from every place and even all beasts shall go in to their dark hiding places. The population of the entire universe shuts their doors and dark night overcomes them. They go inside and stay within the dark night in their hiding places.

Very great is this mystery revealed by the sun! For when the sun rises and [be]come[s] visible at the beginning of the day all people open their doors, and all of humanity and every creature emerges onto the ear[th] to destroy this Light Cross that is established i[n] silence.

This pertains to the mystery of the First Man, because when he came out from the grea[t]ness he shone forth over all the children of Darkness. At that mome[nt] all the children of Darkness came forth from their storehouses, its powers and its armies, abandoning their caves and their black abyss. They destroyed the [outer] body of his five sons, who were swathed over hi[s b]o[dy, in t]hat first struggle.

Again, when the sun sinks from the universe and sets, and all people go in to their hiding places and houses and conceal themselves; this also pertains to the mystery of the end, as it presages the consummation of the universe. For, when all the light will be purified and redeemed i[n] the universe at the last, the collector of all things, the Last Statue, will gather in and sculpt it/self. It is the last hour of the day, the time when the Last Statue will go up to the aeo[n of] light. The enemy too, Death, will go in to bondage; to the prison of the souls of the de[ni]iers and blasphemers who loved the darkness. They will go in with it to bondage and the dark night overcomes th[em]; and thenceforth this name 'light' will not shine upon them.
Behold the two mysteries made visible daily in the sun, which is this splendrous light-giver.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading confirms "external form of truth... arrayed as protecting truths around that interior celestial state," and "outer" is the standard Kephalaia-register term for the external protective body/armor of the First Man's five sons (Light Elements) that was consumed by the powers of Darkness in the first combat.
